#!/bin/sh
# Written by AppKata for its sandboxed apps (requirement 17.6.3): opens links and files on the host
# through the OpenURI portal, instead of starting a host program inside the sandbox.
set -u
case "${1:-}" in ""|-*) exec /usr/bin/xdg-open "$@" ;; esac
if [ -z "${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
  echo "AppKata: this app runs Strict, with no desktop services, so it can't open $1 on this computer (App Detail > Sandbox to change that)." >&2
  exit 3
fi
case "$1" in
  file://*|/*|./*|../*) ;;
  *:*)
    if command -v gdbus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      exec gdbus call --session --dest org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop --object-path /org/freedesktop/portal/desktop \
        --method org.freedesktop.portal.OpenURI.OpenURI "" "$1" '{}' >/dev/null
    elif command -v busctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      exec busctl --user call org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop /org/freedesktop/portal/desktop \
        org.freedesktop.portal.OpenURI OpenURI 'ssa{sv}' "" "$1" 0 >/dev/null
    fi
    echo "AppKata: neither gdbus nor busctl is available to open $1 on the host" >&2; exit 3 ;;
esac
# The Python below exits 0 when the host opened the file (or is still asking), 4 when the host could
# not open it (said on stderr), 5 when the user cancelled; anything else is the call itself failing.
python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import os, sys, urllib.parse
from gi.repository import Gio, GLib
target = sys.argv[1]
if target.startswith("file://"):
    target = urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(target).path)
fdl = Gio.UnixFDList.new()
i = fdl.append(os.open(target, os.O_RDONLY))
bus = Gio.bus_get_sync(Gio.BusType.SESSION, None)
# The call returns a Request at once; whether the host could open the file comes later, as the
# Request's Response signal (0 opened, 1 the user cancelled a chooser, 2 failed). Wait for it, as
# GLib does, so a file the host can't locate -- one in this app's private home -- is reported here
# rather than opening nothing in silence (round five, R5-6: shown with the real portal).
token = "appkata%d" % os.getpid()
req = "/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop/request/%s/%s" % (bus.get_unique_name()[1:].replace(".", "_"), token)
loop, result = GLib.MainLoop(), {}
def response(conn, sender, path, iface, signal, params):
    result["code"] = params.unpack()[0]
    loop.quit()
bus.signal_subscribe("org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop", "org.freedesktop.portal.Request", "Response", req, None,
                     Gio.DBusSignalFlags.NONE, response)
bus.call_with_unix_fd_list_sync("org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop", "/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop",
    "org.freedesktop.portal.OpenURI", "OpenFile",
    GLib.Variant("(sha{sv})", ("", i, {"handle_token": GLib.Variant("s", token)})), None,
    Gio.DBusCallFlags.NONE, 30000, fdl, None)
GLib.timeout_add_seconds(120, loop.quit)       # a chooser may be up; past that, assume the host has it
loop.run()
code = result.get("code", 0)
if code == 2:
    print("AppKata: the host couldn't open %s. A file in this app's private home isn't visible outside the sandbox; "
          "keep it in a folder the app is given (App Detail > Sandbox) to open it on this computer." % sys.argv[1], file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(4)
sys.exit(5 if code == 1 else 0)
PY
st=$?
[ "$st" = 0 ] && exit 0
{ [ "$st" = 4 ] || [ "$st" = 5 ]; } && exit 1
echo "AppKata: couldn't ask the host to open $1 (is python3-gi installed?)" >&2; exit 3

import os, shlex, sys, urllib.parse
ident, rt, rest = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]
sep = rest.index("--")
visible = [os.path.realpath(d) for d in rest[:sep]]
args = rest[sep + 1:]


def seen_inside(path):
    real = os.path.realpath(path)
    return any(real == v or real.startswith(v + os.sep) for v in visible)


def as_file(arg):
    if arg.startswith("file://"):
        u = urllib.parse.urlsplit(arg)
        return (urllib.parse.unquote(u.path), True) if u.netloc in ("", "localhost") else (None, True)
    if "://" in arg:
        return None, False
    return arg, False


bus = None


def export(path):
    global bus
    from gi.repository import Gio, GLib
    if bus is None:
        bus = Gio.bus_get_sync(Gio.BusType.SESSION, None)
    fdl = Gio.UnixFDList.new()
    i = fdl.append(os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY))
    res, _ = bus.call_with_unix_fd_list_sync(
        "org.freedesktop.portal.Documents", "/org/freedesktop/portal/documents", "org.freedesktop.portal.Documents",
        "Add", GLib.Variant("(hbb)", (i, True, False)), GLib.VariantType("(s)"), Gio.DBusCallFlags.NONE, 5000, fdl, None)
    doc = res.unpack()[0]
    perms = ["read"] + (["write"] if os.access(path, os.W_OK) else [])
    bus.call_sync("org.freedesktop.portal.Documents", "/org/freedesktop/portal/documents", "org.freedesktop.portal.Documents",
                  "GrantPermissions", GLib.Variant("(ssas)", (doc, ident, perms)), None, Gio.DBusCallFlags.NONE, 5000, None)
    return os.path.join(rt, "doc", doc, os.path.basename(path))


out = []
for a in args:
    path, uri = as_file(a)
    if path and os.path.isfile(path) and not seen_inside(path):
        inner = export(path)
        a = "file://" + urllib.parse.quote(inner) if uri else inner
    out.append(a)
print(" ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in out))

#!/bin/sh
# Generated by AppKata for Demo. Do not edit — regenerated on update / settings change (req 17.4).
set -eu
id=io.appkata.demo
rt="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
home=$HOME/.local/share/appkata/sandboxes/demo
info=$HOME/.local/share/appkata/sandboxes/.identity/demo
appdir=$HOME/bin/apps/demo/1.0
exe=bin/demo
# Without a session runtime folder (no logind session: ssh without one, cron, a bare container)
# nothing below can work -- the proxy socket, the display sockets and the document view all live
# there -- so say which folder is missing rather than fail on the first mkdir.
mkdir -p "$home" "$rt/appkata" || { echo "AppKata: can't use the session's runtime folder $rt (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR); the sandbox needs a logged-in session." >&2; exit 1; }
# Where stderr goes (requirement 14.2). Started by AppKata's Open, it is already this app's log.
# Started from the app menu, a file manager or a shortcut -- the desktop entry passes the word
# --appkata-menu first -- there is no terminal, so nothing would show a refused launch: stderr is
# appended to that same log, rotated at 2 MB like AppKata's own, under a dated line. Started any
# other way (a command link in a terminal or a script) it stays the caller's, so a tool's `2>file`
# and pipelines keep meaning what they say. $logging tells the run-time line below.
log=$HOME/.local/state/appkata/apps/Demo.log
logging=0
if [ /dev/fd/2 -ef "$log" ]; then
  logging=1
elif [ "${1:-}" = --appkata-menu ]; then
  shift
  mkdir -p "${log%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ "$(stat -c %s "$log" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -gt 2097152 ]; then mv -f "$log" "${log%.log}-prev.log"; fi
  if printf -- '--- %s AppKata: starting %s (from the menu)\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" Demo >> "$log" 2>/dev/null; then
    exec 2>>"$log"
    logging=1
  fi
fi
# A file the app was given as an argument ("Open with", a drop on the menu entry, `tool ~/x.txt`)
# is a host path the sandbox can't see unless it lies in a granted folder: the rest are handed over
# through the document portal from the host side, and the argument becomes the path the app sees.
# Without python3-gi or a document portal the arguments pass through unchanged (requirement 17.6.2).
if [ $# -gt 0 ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if fwd=$(python3 $HOME/.local/share/appkata/sandboxes/.identity/forward-files.py "$id" "$rt"  -- "$@" 2>/dev/null); then eval "set -- $fwd"; fi
fi
# The bwrap words decided at run time are prepended to "$@", ahead of the program and its own
# arguments, each word quoted -- so paths and values with spaces or glob characters stay whole.
set -- -- "$appdir/$exe" "$@"

guard() {
  case "$1" in "$HOME"/*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  rel=${1#"$HOME"/}; p=$home
  while [ -n "$rel" ]; do
    case "$rel" in */*) seg=${rel%%/*}; rel=${rel#*/} ;; *) seg=$rel; rel= ;; esac
    [ -n "$seg" ] || continue
    p="$p/$seg"
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
      echo "AppKata: removing a link the app left at $p (a mount point)." >&2
      rm -f "$p"
    fi
    [ -e "$p" ] || return 0
  done
}

sock="$rt/appkata/bus-$id.$$"
rm -f "$sock"
# Read the host bus with a default so `set -u` can't abort the launcher when it is unset.
upstream="${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS:-}"
# Proxy in its own tmpfs-root bwrap, with $rt bound rw so its socket is visible to the
# launcher (the P1 gotcha, resolved — local-proxy-test-plan.md). It carries *no*
# /.flatpak-info: the portals judge the caller by the proxy's root, and xdg-desktop-portal
# 1.18+ refuses a marked caller that is not a running Flatpak (requirement 17.6.1), so the
# app is a host caller to them and the proxy allows only the portal interfaces safe for one.
bwrap --ro-bind /usr /usr --symlink usr/lib /lib --symlink usr/lib64 /lib64 \
  --symlink usr/bin /bin --ro-bind /etc /etc --proc /proc --dev /dev \
  --bind "$rt" "$rt" --die-with-parent -- \
  xdg-dbus-proxy "$upstream" "$sock" --filter '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.OpenURI.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Settings.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Print.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Email.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.NetworkMonitor.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.ProxyResolver.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.MemoryMonitor.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Request.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop/request/*' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Session.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop/session/*' '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' --broadcast=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Settings.SettingChanged@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop --broadcast=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.NetworkMonitor.changed@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop --broadcast=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.MemoryMonitor.LowMemoryWarning@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop --own=io.appkata.demo '--call=org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop=org.freedesktop.portal.Notification.*@/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop' --talk=org.freedesktop.Notifications &
proxy=$!
# Wait for the socket, but stop early if the proxy died (e.g. no host bus) instead of
# blocking for the full timeout.
i=0; while [ ! -S "$sock" ] && kill -0 "$proxy" 2>/dev/null && [ "$i" -lt 50 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.1; done

x11=0
if [ -n "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -e "$rt/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" ]; then
  set -- --ro-bind "$rt/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" "$rt/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" --setenv WAYLAND_DISPLAY "$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" "$@"
  [ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ] && x11=1
elif [ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
  x11=1
fi
if [ "$x11" = 1 ]; then
  set -- --ro-bind-try /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.X11-unix --setenv DISPLAY "$DISPLAY" "$@"
  xa="${XAUTHORITY:-$HOME/.Xauthority}"
  if [ -e "$xa" ]; then guard "$xa"; set -- --ro-bind "$xa" "$xa" --setenv XAUTHORITY "$xa" "$@"; fi
fi

rc=$(readlink -f /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || true)
case "$rc" in
  /run/systemd/resolve/*) set -- --ro-bind /run/systemd/resolve /run/systemd/resolve "$@" ;;
  ""|/etc/*|/usr/*) ;;
  *) if [ -e "$rc" ]; then set -- --ro-bind "$rc" "$rc" "$@"; fi ;;
esac

for d in /usr/share/applications /usr/local/share/applications; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then set -- --tmpfs "$d" "$@"; fi
done

for v in LANG LANGUAGE LC_ALL LC_CTYPE LC_MESSAGES LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME TERM USER LOGNAME XDG_SESSION_TYPE XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP DESKTOP_SESSION GTK_THEME QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE XCURSOR_THEME XCURSOR_SIZE GDK_SCALE GDK_DPI_SCALE QT_SCALE_FACTOR; do
  eval "isset=\${$v+1}"
  [ -n "$isset" ] || continue
  eval "val=\$$v"
  set -- --setenv "$v" "$val" "$@"
done
for d in "$HOME/.themes" "$HOME/.icons" "$HOME/.fonts" "$HOME/.config/fontconfig" "$HOME/.local/share/fonts" "$HOME/.local/share/icons" "$HOME/.local/share/themes" "$appdir"; do guard "$d"; done

if [ "$logging" = 1 ]; then printf 'AppKata: running %s (%s)\n' "$appdir/$exe" "$(date +%s)" >&2; fi
status=0
exec 3< $HOME/.local/share/appkata/sandboxes/.identity/seccomp-tty.bpf
bwrap \
  --ro-bind /usr /usr --symlink usr/lib /lib --symlink usr/lib64 /lib64 \
  --symlink usr/bin /bin --symlink usr/sbin /sbin --ro-bind /etc /etc \
  --ro-bind-try /var/cache/fontconfig /var/cache/fontconfig \
  --proc /proc --dev /dev --dev-bind-try /dev/dri /dev/dri --tmpfs /tmp --dir "$rt" \
  --bind-try "$rt/doc/by-app/$id" "$rt/doc" \
  --ro-bind-try /sys/block /sys/block --ro-bind-try /sys/bus /sys/bus --ro-bind-try /sys/class /sys/class \
  --ro-bind-try /sys/dev /sys/dev --ro-bind-try /sys/devices /sys/devices \
  --bind "$home" "$HOME" --ro-bind "$appdir" "$appdir" \
  --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.themes" "$HOME/.themes" --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.icons" "$HOME/.icons" \
  --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.fonts" "$HOME/.fonts" --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.config/fontconfig" "$HOME/.config/fontconfig" \
  --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.local/share/fonts" "$HOME/.local/share/fonts" \
  --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.local/share/icons" "$HOME/.local/share/icons" \
  --ro-bind-try "$HOME/.local/share/themes" "$HOME/.local/share/themes" \
  --ro-bind-try "$rt/pipewire-0" "$rt/pipewire-0" \
  --ro-bind-try "$rt/pulse/native" "$rt/pulse/native" \
  --ro-bind "$info" /.flatpak-info \
  --bind "$sock" "$rt/bus" \
  --ro-bind-try $HOME/.local/share/appkata/sandboxes/.identity/bin /run/appkata \
  --unshare-all --share-net --die-with-parent --seccomp 3 \
  --clearenv --setenv HOME "$HOME" --setenv PATH /run/appkata:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
  --setenv XDG_RUNTIME_DIR "$rt" \
  --setenv DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS "unix:path=$rt/bus" \
  --chdir "$HOME" \
  "$@" || status=$?

kill "$proxy" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$sock"
exit $status
